policy.platform: one NVIDIA A100 80GB GPU per run.
policy.forbidden: the MLPerf Inference results repositories (mlcommons/inference_results_*), published MLPerf submissions, or the MLCommons results tables

tasks.task_prompt: Run `./run_local.sh ncnn resnet50 cpu --accuracy` (Offline scenario, LoadGen accuracy mode) on the fp32 ncnn model resnet50_v1 over the ImageNet-2012 validation set, then tools/accuracy-imagenet.py on its LoadGen accuracy log.

Run `./run_local.sh onnxruntime resnet50 gpu --accuracy` (Offline scenario, LoadGen accuracy mode) on the fp32 model resnet50_v1.onnx over the ImageNet-2012 validation set, then tools/accuracy-imagenet.py on its LoadGen accuracy log.

log_lines.onnxruntime providers:: the active providers of its inference session (`InferenceSession.get_providers()`)

tasks.task_prompt: Run `./run_local.sh pytorch resnet50 gpu --accuracy` (Offline scenario, LoadGen accuracy mode) on the fp32 checkpoint resnet50-19c8e357.pth over the ImageNet-2012 validation set, then tools/accuracy-imagenet.py on its LoadGen accuracy log.

log_lines.pytorch device:: the device the model's parameters are on

tasks.task_prompt: Run `./run_local.sh tvm-pytorch resnet50 cpu --accuracy` (Offline scenario, LoadGen accuracy mode) on the A:int8 W:uint8 model resnet50_INT8bit_quantized.pt over the ImageNet-2012 validation set, then tools/accuracy-imagenet.py on its LoadGen accuracy log.

Run `./run_local.sh tf resnet50 gpu --accuracy` (Offline scenario, LoadGen accuracy mode) on the fp32 graph resnet50_v1.pb over the ImageNet-2012 validation set, then tools/accuracy-imagenet.py on its LoadGen accuracy log.

Run `./run_local.sh onnxruntime retinanet gpu --accuracy` (Offline scenario, LoadGen accuracy mode) on the fp32 model resnext50_32x4d_fpn.onnx over the OpenImages mlperf validation set at 800x800, then tools/accuracy-openimages.py on its LoadGen accuracy log.

log_lines.onnxruntime providers:: the active providers of its inference session (`InferenceSession.get_providers()`)

tasks.task_prompt: Run `./run_local.sh pytorch retinanet gpu --accuracy` (Offline scenario, LoadGen accuracy mode) on the fp32 checkpoint resnext50_32x4d_fpn.pth over the OpenImages mlperf validation set at 800x800, then tools/accuracy-openimages.py on its LoadGen accuracy log.

log_lines.pytorch device:: the device the model's parameters are on
